title: Catches and retries a degenerating reply before you see it
body: When a reply runs on with no sentence breaks for too long, repeats the same chunk of text, or its internal reasoning degenerates the same way, Jabber now detects it and automatically retries the answer once -- covers both regular and streaming replies -- instead of shipping broken or repetitive text.

title: Sage answers get checked against what was actually queried
body: If a reply states a Sage table, column, or report name that never actually appeared in that turn's real Sage query results, Jabber catches it and retries instead of letting an unconfirmed name slip through. Same check applies to claims that DocLink, Wrike, or Sage access is "working" or "verified" when no real call to that system ran this turn.

title: Ask for a real PDF and it'll build one
body: Give it a title and some sections and it writes a real .pdf document, with a download link -- not a Word doc you have to Save As yourself.

title: Merge PDFs together
body: Point it at two or more PDFs already in a project and it combines them into one, in whatever order you want.

title: Reorder, add, duplicate, or remove PDF pages
body: Rearrange a PDF's pages, drop ones you don't want, repeat one that needs to show up twice, or rotate a page -- all without touching the original file.

title: Stamp or watermark an existing PDF
body: Add a DRAFT or APPROVED mark, a date, or a diagonal watermark to any page of a PDF you already have.

title: A fresh hello every time
body: The greeting on the home screen now picks from a rotating set of lines instead of saying the exact same thing every single time.

title: Projects got their own page
body: Clicking a project now opens a real page for it instead of a settings popup -- recent chats, instructions, and files for that project all live there, with a composer to start a new chat right from it.

title: Upload files straight into your library
body: You can now add a file directly to your personal library, not just inside a project.

title: Faster, more complete file searches
body: Searching company files for several keywords, or across every area at once, now takes one search instead of many, so broad sweeps finish faster and cover more ground. Jabber also now remembers what it already searched when you ask it to keep going, so saying continue picks up where it left off instead of starting over.

title: Generate and edit images right in chat
body: Ask for an image and it'll actually generate one, or paste/upload a photo and ask for changes -- recolor, add or remove something, restyle it. Works for pilot accounts.

title: Ask for a QR code
body: Just ask -- QR codes are generated directly, not through the image model, so they're always scannable.

title: Generated files and documents now stick around
body: Images, spreadsheets, documents, and presentations you generate no longer disappear after 48 hours. They're kept in your own personal library with no size limit for now.

title: Fixed image generation sometimes failing for two people at once
body: If two requests landed at the same moment, both could fail outright. Requests now queue properly instead of colliding.

title: Legal files access (pilot)
body: A new read-only Legal files connection is available for pilot users, alongside the existing Jobs and Sales connections.

title: Removed the Everforest theme
body: The Everforest theme option has been removed from the theme picker. It overlapped too closely with the other themes already offered.

title: Sidebar: Chats section below Projects
body: The old "History" section is now called "Chats" and sits right under your projects, with its own collapse arrow just like Projects.

title: Fixed sidebar search
body: Search was silently failing to show results if the Chats section was collapsed, and only searched within whichever project you had open. Search now always shows its results and looks across everything.

title: Sources panel now grouped by search
body: The right-hand sources panel now groups results by which search they came from, matching how they're already grouped above the chat, instead of one long mixed list.

title: No more delay after a quiet period
body: The model now stays loaded and ready instead of unloading after a few minutes of inactivity, so your first message after a break shouldn't have to wait for it to reload.

title: Settings page cleanup
body: Settings sections now have clearer visual separation. Removed Behavior and Conversation Data; Feedback is hidden until it's fully tested. Usage is now "Your usage", with real calendar dates instead of day names. Project icons now use a transparent background instead of a color swatch.

title: See the model's reasoning
body: For users who have it turned on, you can now expand and read the model's step-by-step reasoning behind a reply, not just the final answer.

title: Fixed replies drifting into gibberish
body: Fixed a bug where a long reply could drift away from real words into a chain of loosely related synonyms instead of actual sentences. Long replies read coherently all the way through now.

title: Fixed replies that could run away and freeze chat
body: Found and fixed a bug where a single reply could occasionally spiral into an endless repetitive loop, tying up the server until someone restarted it by hand. Replies are now automatically capped so this can't happen again.

title: Download Wrike attachments from chat
body: Attachments Jabber finds on a Wrike task can now be downloaded straight from the conversation.

title: Live Sage (ERP) lookups
body: For users with it turned on, Jabber can now look up real data in Sage and bring it into its answer instead of only working from what you typed.

title: Images in chat
body: You can now paste or attach images directly into a conversation.
